Vanessa / team — I reviewed the numbers in redwood_pricing_ramp_2-3yr.xlsx. High level: we can stretch to 27% on a 3-year non-refundable prepay, but only if the following conditions are contractually embedded:

Sara / BrightLayer team — thanks for the patience. We reviewed your SOW notes and have incorporated a commercial-safe approach that addresses your ramp concerns while protecting both parties. Summary of the final proposal: 

- 2-year prepay: 18% discount, standard ramp (50% commit in Y1, 100% by end of Q3 Y1). No ramp credits.
- 3-year prepay: 27% discount (one-time executive exception), terms as follows:
   - Payment: 12 months upfront, remaining 24 months invoiced quarterly but considered committed (non-refundable).
   - Ramp credits: two credits (each equal to 5% of annual committed spend) applied if BrightLayer misses pre-agreed quarterly commit thresholds; credits are capped at 10% total annual spend and expire after year 1.
   - SLA / termination: 60-day cure period for specified SLO breaches. If Redwood misses the agreed SLOs for two consecutive quarters after the cure period, BrightLayer may elect for termination with a limited redemption equal to unutilized committed credits (no cash-back).

This structure meets your ask for stronger ramp protection while avoiding broad termination-for-convenience exposure. Attached is a redlined term sheet and the revised SOW. If this is acceptable, Chloe will send the official commercial proposal and DocuSign later today.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
